## Personality

Thomas Sowerby is a quiet and small man. Among the locals of [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), he is known simply as [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) Sowerby's husband.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)_

## History

Thomas Sowerby lacked willpower throughout his life, being commanded by his mother until his marriage to [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), at which point he planted lilies and [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) took over directing him. After his death, [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) proposed inviting his widowed wife to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters).

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P37](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0037), [v3 ch.Home P14](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0014)_

## Background by volume

## Relationships

### [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--thomas-sowerby.md)

Thomas Sowerby was the husband of [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) until his death in Volume 2. Following his passing, his widowed wife was invited by [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to move into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) so that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) could attend college.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), +11 more_
